cohort: Eleven women with an ultra-short uterine cervix
finding: Although there are risks of various complications as a result of the use of non-absorbable thread and the need for two extra laparotomies, TAC can be a safe and useful option for patients who show cervical incompetence after large uterine cervical operations, such as RT or large conization.
mod_finding: Five of the women underwent scheduled cesarean sections.
